_note: The fallback region style pack (Map v5): used where no other pack's bboxes hold the region. Neutral defaults — kerbs and footpaths on urban streets, plain markings, grey roofs and render walls.
name: Generic

crossSection._note: Each side of a road, out from its edge: kerb (a bevelled step kerbHeight high over kerbBevel, then kerbTop of flat top), verge (grass; street trees), footpath, then the property's edge. byClass: whether a road of that class has kerbs and footpaths where nothing's mapped (urban only: within urbanReach m of urbanBuildings buildings on that side), and the verge's and footpath's widths. Mapped sidewalks (footway=sidewalk within sidewalkSnap m, running alongside) set the footpath's place instead; sidewalk=no/separate are respected. Where buildings stand within shopfrontWithin m of the kerb in a commercial or industrial area (pavedLanduse) — a shopping street — or within pavedWithin m anywhere, the footpath runs to their walls (paved, no verge). Kerbs are lowered (flush) within lowerAt m of a crossing or a driveway's mouth, over lowerRamp m. A footpath falls crossfall to the kerb.

islands._note: Raised islands: a hole in the road's surface (inside a roundabout, between a junction's lanes) no bigger than maxArea m² is filled. A roundabout's (a hole ringed by one-way roads, round enough: compactness at least roundness) is a garden bed — bark mulch, low plants every plantSpacing m, a tree in the middle if it's at least treeRadius m across — behind a raised kerb; the others concrete (smaller than paveBelow m²) or grass. Mapped data first (OSM's landuse/natural on it); these are the defaults, marked estimated.

vegetation._note: The mix of trees and plants: species shapes (map/render/objects.ts) by share — dry eucalypts, brown summer grass. Street trees every streetTreeSpacing m along a verge at least streetTreeVerge m wide (estimated where none are mapped, seeded by the road's id).

buildings._note: Roofs and walls where the data doesn't say (seeded by the building's id; marked estimated): a house's roof terracotta tiles or Colorbond steel, its walls brick or render; front fences estimated along a house's frontage when frontFences.

furniture._note: Street furniture's designs: traffic lights (a black pole, three lenses, a backing board), street lights (a galvanised pole, an arm out over the road, light brightness: data/map/v5.json lamps), power poles (Stobie poles — steel and concrete — every poleSpacing m along streets that have them mapped; estimated only when estimatePoles), signs (the AU set: red octagon STOP, red-bordered triangle GIVE WAY, white speed-limit circle).

tunnel._note: map/model/tunnels.ts: a tunnel's tube — its walls height m up from the road's edges (a band m high at their foot), its ceiling height m over the road; a portal's headwall above m over the hillside, its wings wing m out either side.

fields._note: map/model/fields.ts: sports grounds' line colour, a cricket pitch's strip, courts' surfaces by sport, pools' water and coping.
